"""Core task operations. due_at throughout this module is in SECONDS, matching models.Task."""
import time

from tinytasks.models import Task
from tinytasks.storage import load_all, next_id, save_all


def create_task(title: str, due_in_seconds: float) -> Task:
    """Create a task due `due_in_seconds` seconds from now."""
    tasks = load_all()
    task = Task(id=next_id(tasks), title=title, due_at=time.time() + due_in_seconds)
    tasks.append(task)
    save_all(tasks)
    return task


def get_overdue_tasks(now: float | None = None) -> list[Task]:
    """Tasks whose due_at (seconds) has already passed."""
    now = now if now is not None else time.time()
    return [t for t in load_all() if t.due_at < now and not t.archived]


def delete_task(task_id: int) -> bool:
    tasks = load_all()
    remaining = [t for t in tasks if t.id != task_id]
    save_all(remaining)
    return len(remaining) != len(tasks)


def archive_task(task_id: int) -> bool:
    """Soft-delete a task: mark it archived but keep the record."""
    tasks = load_all()
    for t in tasks:
        if t.id == task_id:
            t.archived = True
            save_all(tasks)
            return True
    return False


def clear_overdue(now: float | None = None) -> int:
    """Soft-delete (archive) all overdue tasks; return how many were archived."""
    now = now if now is not None else time.time()
    tasks = load_all()
    count = 0
    for t in tasks:
        if t.due_at < now and not t.archived:
            t.archived = True
            count += 1
    if count:
        save_all(tasks)
    return count


def remove_tasks(ids: list[int]) -> int:
    """Soft-delete (archive) the given tasks; return how many were newly archived."""
    wanted = set(ids)
    tasks = load_all()
    count = 0
    for t in tasks:
        if t.id in wanted and not t.archived:
            t.archived = True
            count += 1
    if count:
        save_all(tasks)
    return count


def rename_task(task_id: int, new_title: str) -> bool:
    """Change a task's title; return False if no such task."""
    tasks = load_all()
    for t in tasks:
        if t.id == task_id:
            t.title = new_title
            save_all(tasks)
            return True
    return False

from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass
class Task:
    id: int
    title: str
    due_at: float  # unix timestamp, seconds
    archived: bool = False
import argparse

from tinytasks.api import (
    clear_overdue,
    create_task,
    delete_task,
    get_overdue_tasks,
    remove_tasks,
    rename_task,
)
from tinytasks.text import normalize_title


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="tinytasks")
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

    p_add = sub.add_parser("add")
    p_add.add_argument("title")
    p_add.add_argument("--due-in", type=float, required=True, help="seconds from now")

    sub.add_parser("overdue")

    p_del = sub.add_parser("delete")
    p_del.add_argument("id", type=int)

    sub.add_parser("clear-overdue")

    p_quick = sub.add_parser("quick-add")
    p_quick.add_argument("title")

    p_rm = sub.add_parser("rm")
    p_rm.add_argument("ids", type=int, nargs="+", metavar="ID")

    p_rename = sub.add_parser("rename")
    p_rename.add_argument("id", type=int)
    p_rename.add_argument("new_title")

    a = ap.parse_args()
    if a.cmd == "add":
        t = create_task(normalize_title(a.title), a.due_in)
        print(f"created task {t.id}: {t.title} (due_at={t.due_at})")
    elif a.cmd == "overdue":
        for t in get_overdue_tasks():
            print(f"{t.id}: {t.title} (due_at={t.due_at})")
    elif a.cmd == "clear-overdue":
        print(clear_overdue())
    elif a.cmd == "quick-add":
        t = create_task(normalize_title(a.title), 24 * 3600)
        print(f"created task {t.id}: {t.title} (due_at={t.due_at})")
    elif a.cmd == "rm":
        print(remove_tasks(a.ids))
    elif a.cmd == "rename":
        print("renamed" if rename_task(a.id, normalize_title(a.new_title)) else "no such task")
    elif a.cmd == "delete":
        print("deleted" if delete_task(a.id) else "no such task")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Text helpers for task titles."""

MAX_TITLE_LENGTH = 80

"""Plain-JSON storage for tasks.

The data file defaults to tinytasks/data.json; set TINYTASKS_DATA to point elsewhere.
"""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from tinytasks.models import Task

DEFAULT_PATH = Path(__file__).parent / "data.json"


def _resolve(path: Path | None) -> Path:
    if path is not None:
        return path
    env = os.environ.get("TINYTASKS_DATA")
    return Path(env) if env else DEFAULT_PATH


def load_all(path: Path | None = None) -> list[Task]:
    path = _resolve(path)
    if not path.exists():
        return []
    raw = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return [Task(**r) for r in raw]


def save_all(tasks: list[Task], path: Path | None = None) -> None:
    path = _resolve(path)
    path.write_text(json.dumps([t.__dict__ for t in tasks], indent=2), encoding="utf-8")


def next_id(tasks: list[Task]) -> int:
    return (max((t.id for t in tasks), default=0)) + 1
    assert clear_overdue() == 0

    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    create_task("late", due_in_seconds=-10)
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["tinytasks", "clear-overdue"])
    main()
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == "1"


def test_cli_quick_add_due_in_24h_and_normalized(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    before = time.time()
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["tinytasks", "quick-add", "  buy   milk "])
    main()
    (t,) = load_all()
    assert t.title == "buy milk"
    assert 86400 - 100 < t.due_at - before < 86400 + 100


def test_cli_rm_multiple_ids(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    a = create_task("a", due_in_seconds=60)
    b = create_task("b", due_in_seconds=60)
    c = create_task("c", due_in_seconds=60)
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["tinytasks", "rm", str(a.id), str(b.id)])
    main()
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == "2"
    assert [t.title for t in load_all() if not t.archived] == ["c"]
    assert len(load_all()) == 3

    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("old", due_in_seconds=60)
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["tinytasks", "rename", str(t.id), "  new   name "])
    main()
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == "renamed"
    assert load_all()[0].title == "new name"

def dedupe_tasks() -> int:
    """Soft-delete (archive) tasks sharing an exact title, keeping the earliest due_at; return count archived."""
    tasks = load_all()
    keepers: dict[str, Task] = {}
    for t in tasks:
        if t.archived:
            continue
        best = keepers.get(t.title)
        if best is None or t.due_at < best.due_at:
            keepers[t.title] = t
    count = 0
    for t in tasks:
        if not t.archived and keepers[t.title] is not t:
            t.archived = True
            count += 1
    if count:
        save_all(tasks)
    return count


def copy_task(task_id: int, title: str) -> Task | None:
    """Create a new task with `title` and the same due_at as `task_id`; None if no such task."""
    tasks = load_all()
    for t in tasks:
        if t.id == task_id:
            new = Task(id=next_id(tasks), title=title, due_at=t.due_at)
            tasks.append(new)
            save_all(tasks)
            return new
    return None
